published.waived: S029 ONLY. The 2018 NEJM erratum (PMID 31442371, DOI 10.1056/NEJMx180040), a single notice covering thirteen articles, applies to Eggermont et al. EORTC 18071. We have not read it and cannot: NEJM returns 403 to a script, Europe PMC records it as neither open access nor in its archive, and neither PubMed nor Crossref carries an abstract. Operator ruling 2026-09-09: publish. Grounds — (1) the page discloses the gap to the reader in the S029 source note, naming the erratum and saying we have not read it and do not know whether it touches a figure quoted here; (2) the claim that rests on this paper is that one adjuvant checkpoint inhibitor reported an OS benefit against placebo as a prespecified secondary endpoint at a dose and toxicity that kept it from standard care, which survives any decimal-level correction and would fall only to a retraction, and retractions are not issued as one line in a thirteen-paper notice; (3) removing a true, well-sourced counterexample on the strength of an unread notice would restore the impression OR-008 exists to correct. Corroboration, labelled as corroboration and not as closure: every figure quoted from this paper appears in the PubMed record of PMID 27717298 retrieved 2026-09-09, which post-dates the erratum. S029 keeps an open, undispositioned errata item. If the notice is ever obtained and touches a figure on this page, that is a correction and goes in the log. This waive covers S029 and nothing else.
